summary: Regression passed: mobile results fit within 390px, three concise recommendations render, report controls remain readable, and PDF/DOCX/XLSX downloads succeed.
seed_data_creation: Live regression created TEST_live_beam_review, TEST_JPEG, TEST_PNG, and TEST_WEBP records; records remain in history.
context_for_next_testing_agent: At 390px, document/body scrollWidth is 390px and results/main are 322px. History result showed exactly three recommendations, no page error elements, and all report buttons stayed within viewport. Downloads returned .pdf, .docx, and .xlsx.
rca of the issue: Iteration 5 overflow was resolved by constraining result containers and adding overflow-safe wrapping; no residual horizontal overflow reproduced. The existing pytest file requires TEST_BASE_URL; it passed when supplied from frontend/.env.
